goal: Remediation plan: a dated plan for fixing a group of related findings.
use: Remediation plan: a dated plan for fixing a group of related findings. Use when several related findings need fixing together.

steps.note: Group the findings by component or cause.
Choose the fix. One upgrade, one configuration or one code change per group.
Set the dates. Each group gets an owner and a deadline.
Plan the test. Note how the fix will be verified.
Report. The groups, the fix, the owner, the date and the verification.
